name: Still Alive: Idle
summary:
Still Alive: Idle is a browser-based post-apocalyptic idle survival game set in Britain. Players manage survivors from a refuge, developing survival skills while scavenging, fishing, trapping, crafting, cooking and exploring the surrounding world. Survivors leave the safety of their base to gather resources, discover locations and uncover the story of the collapse through exploration, documents and environmental storytelling.

Progress continues through an idle activity system, with survivors improving their skills, equipment and refuge over time. The game combines idle progression with survival resource management, exploration and risk.
